# Architecture & Modularity Quality Checklist: Decomposição de Módulos Extensos (Feature 049)

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality checklist validating the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of modularity, line-count boundaries (OPP-002), facade patterns, non-breaking contract preservation, and state integrity requirements for the refactoring.  
**Created**: 2026-10-21  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Limites de Tamanho e Segregação de Responsabilidades (SRP & Modularity)

- [ ] CHK001 Are the line-count threshold constraints (strictly ≤ 400 lines per file) explicitly defined for all 4 target modules and all newly created subcomponents? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the specification clearly define single-responsibility boundaries for the extracted subcomponents of `Task.tsx`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the boundaries and responsibilities between `App.tsx`, `AppDialogsContainer.tsx`, and `AppHeaderBar.tsx` unambiguously separated without overlapping state ownership? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications Q3]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the definition of "submódulo especializado" quantified in terms of export cohesion and dependency isolation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Gap]

## 2. Preservação Estrita de Contratos Públicos & Padrão Fachada (Retrocompatibilidade)

- [ ] CHK005 Are non-breaking contract guarantees explicitly defined for all consumer components that import from `src/components/Task.tsx`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the specification mandate that `src/components/TaskDetailsModal.tsx` preserves 100% of its existing public prop interface and event callbacks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the Facade Pattern for `useTaskCollection.ts` defined with explicit preservation of all returned action handlers, mutation methods, and state getters? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications Q2]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the spec forbid breaking changes in barrel/index re-exports or consumer import paths across the repository? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]

## 3. Integridade de Estado, Guards de Salvamento & Proteção de Rascunho

- [ ] CHK009 Is the requirement to preserve the dirty-draft protection guard (`showDirtyConfirmDialog`) and `beforeunload` listener in the refactored modal explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Constitution IX]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the interaction sequences and states for modal dismissal (Escape key, backdrop click, Close button) defined with deterministic guard checks? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the specification specify that task mutations in decomposed hooks must maintain atomic persistence in `localStorage` without race conditions? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Constitution VIII]

## 4. Estabilidade de Interface, Drag-and-Drop & Seletores CSS

- [ ] CHK012 Are drag-and-drop reference forwarding (`innerRef`, draggableProps, dragHandleProps) requirements specified to prevent Kanban card flickering or broken drag sessions? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the specification explicitly prohibit altering, renaming, or removing canonical CSS class selectors across `src/styles/01` to `13` during subcomponent extraction? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Are accessibility attributes (`aria-*`, `role`, keyboard navigation focus order) required to be preserved in the decomposed card and modal trees? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 5. Critérios de Falsificabilidade, Testabilidade & Não-Regressão

- [ ] CHK015 Is the zero-regression criterion (100% of 744 existing automated tests passing) objectively measurable via automated test runners? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Constitution III]
- [ ] CHK016 Are test suite isolation requirements specified so that unit tests can target extracted subcomponents independently from their parent containers? [Testability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the specification require automated verification that no file in the targeted scope exceeds 400 lines of code via static script or CI gate? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Gap]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied in `spec.md` or companion design documents.
- Leave items unchecked (`[ ]`) when requirements still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a quality gate and must not modify reviewer markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add reviewer findings, notes, or cross-references inline as evaluation progresses.
